title: "Simulate the SE2I2R model with covariate and term-forcing"
author: "Laura Andrea Barrrero Guevara"
date: "1/27/2022"
output: html_document
---
################################################################################
Purpose of script: Run simulations for SE2I2R model when Aclimate = -0.08 and 
different term-time forcing (Colombia)
Output:
- {clim_name}_simulations_{i}_R0{R0_val}.Rds (simulations for every mun)
-  all_traj_hum_spe_R010 (all simulations)
################################################################################

# Setup
```{r}
rm(list = ls())
source("04_00_pck.R")
source("fun_createSE2I2Rmod_climcovars.R")
source("fun_reformatsimulations.R")
source("fun_eeunforcedmodel.R")
source("fun_set_cores.R")
source("fun_traj_mod_simulations.R")
dirs$out_sav <- glue("{dirs$outputs}/colombia_climcovars")
```

# Read in municipality names and df_covars
```{r}
dat_mun <- unique((readRDS(glue("{dirs$processed}/data_clim_sel_week_nc_col.rds")) %>%
                           filter(!is.na(w_hum_spe)))$mun_name)
df_covars <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$out_sav}/df_covars.rds"))
```

# Run simulations (R0 = 10) for each municipality, 
# school_amp values 0, 0.10, 0.20, 0.30
```{r}
all_traj_hum_spe_R010 <- list()
for (school_amp in c(0, 0.10, 0.20, 0.30)) {
parallel::clusterExport(cl = my.cluster, varlist = c("dirs", "dat_mun", "df_covars"))
all_traj_hum_spe_R010[[glue("s_{school_amp}")]] <- list(
  foreach(i = dat_mun, 
          .packages = c("glue", "pomp", "stringr", "tidyverse")) %dopar% {
    clim_name <- "w_hum_spe"
    R0_val <- 10
    bake(file = glue("{dirs$out_sav}/{clim_name}_simulations_{i}_R0{R0_val}_SCH{school_amp}.Rds"),{
      mod <- fun_traj_mod_simulations(
              clim_name = clim_name,
              amp_vec = c(-0.08),
              R0_val = R0_val,
              n_years = 200,
              delta_t = 0.1,
              amp_term = school_amp,
              mun = i,
              country_name = "Colombia")
    })
  }
)
all_traj_hum_spe_R010[[glue("s_{school_amp}")]] <- bind_rows(unlist(all_traj_hum_spe_R010[[glue("s_{school_amp}")]], recursive = F))}
```
```{r}
all_traj_hum_spe_R010[["s_0.25"]] <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$out_sav}/w_hum_spe_simulations_all_R010.Rds"))
```

# Plot last 10 years 
```{r, fig.width=8}
bind_rows(all_traj_hum_spe_R010, .id = "amp_school") %>%
  filter(amp_clim == "-0.08") %>%
  separate(amp_school, into = c("vs","amp_school"), sep = "_") %>%
  select(-vs) %>%
  filter(state_var == "I") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = time / 52, y = val, color = factor(amp_school))) + 
    geom_line() + 
    labs(x = "Time (years)", y = "Proportion") + 
    facet_wrap(mun_name~., ncol = 5) + 
    scale_colour_viridis_d(expression(A[2]), end = 0.8, 
                           guide = guide_legend(nrow = 1)) + 
    theme_classic() + 
    theme(legend.position = "top",
          legend.justification = "right",
          strip.background = element_rect(color = "transparent"))
```

# Plot last year
```{r, fig.width=4, fig.height=4}
bind_rows(all_traj_hum_spe_R010, .id = "amp_school") %>%
  filter(amp_clim == "-0.08") %>%
  separate(amp_school, into = c("vs","amp_school"), sep = "_") %>%
  select(-vs) %>%
  filter(year == max(year), state_var == "CC") %>% 
  group_by(mun_name) %>% 
  mutate(val_scaled_mean = val / mean(val)) %>% 
  left_join(distinct(df_covars[,c("mun_name","mun_latitude")])) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = week, y = val_scaled_mean, color = factor(amp_school))) + 
    geom_line() + 
    scale_y_continuous("Rescaled incidence") + 
    scale_x_continuous("Week no", breaks = c(20, 40)) + 
    facet_wrap(reorder(mun_name, -mun_latitude)~., ncol = 5) + 
    scale_colour_viridis_d(expression(A[2]), end = 0.8, 
                           guide = guide_legend(nrow = 1)) + 
    theme_classic() + 
    theme(legend.position = "top",
          legend.justification = "right",
          strip.background = element_rect(color = "transparent"))
```

```{r}
saveRDS(all_traj_hum_spe_R010, 
        file = glue("{dirs$out_sav}/w_hum_spe_simulations_all_R010_SCH.Rds"))
```
